lesson.title: Written A: Answer the questions (about Lesson 139)
lesson.instruction: Read the dialogue in Lesson 139 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 139 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 重读第 139 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 comprehension questions about the Lesson 139 dialogue (Graham and John).

questions.prompt: Is Graham Turner telephoning from his office?
questions.answer: Yes, he is.

questions.prompt: What message does he want John to give Mary?
questions.answer: He wants him to tell Mary they'll be late for dinner this evening.

questions.prompt: What did Mary invite Charlotte and Graham to? And when?
questions.answer: She invited them to dinner this evening.

questions.prompt: Why can't Graham and Charlotte be at John's house at six o'clock?
questions.answer: Because Graham's boss wants him to do some extra work.

lesson.title: Written B: Write indirect questions
lesson.instruction: Write sentences like the example. 按照例句写句子。
lesson.context: 5 indirect question items; item 1 (Sue: Is that man a teacher? → Sue wants to know if that man is a teacher.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Sue: Is that man a teacher? → Sue wants to know if that man is a teacher.
questions.answer: Sue wants to know if that man is a teacher.

questions.prompt: John: Why does Mary teach here? → John wants to know why Mary teaches here.
questions.answer: John wants to know why Mary teaches here.

questions.prompt: Ben: Does that girl speak English? → Ben wants to know if that girl speaks English.
questions.answer: Ben wants to know if that girl speaks English.

questions.prompt: Julie: What is Graham writing? → Julie wants to know what Graham is writing.
questions.answer: Julie wants to know what Graham is writing.

questions.prompt: Gary: Are they coming soon? → Gary wants to know if they are coming soon.
questions.answer: Gary wants to know if they are coming soon.

practice.title: Practice B: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What might you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.context: 2 open-ended situation questions; the workbook answer key gives only possible sample answers.

questions.prompt: Your phone rings. When you pick it up, a voice says: 'Is that you, [your name]?' What do you say?
questions.answer: (Yes,) speaking.

questions.prompt: Someone tells you something which you do not understand at all. It all seems a mystery to you. What do you say?
questions.answer: I'm afraid I don't understand. / I don't know what you're talking about.
